## Overview
The Clinic Management System is a hybrid cloud platform designed to handle patient registration, scheduling, electronic medical records (EMR), and billing for medical clinics. It guarantees HIPAA/GDPR compliance, 99.99% availability, and strict 10-year data retention.

## Key Elements
- **Users & Actors**: Doctors, Nurses, Receptionists, Billing Officers, and Patients.
- **External Systems**: External Lab/Imaging Systems, Insurance Clearinghouses, Payment Gateway (Stripe-like), Identity Provider (Keycloak/Azure AD), and Notification Service (Twilio/AWS SES).
- **Containers**: API Gateway (Kong/NGINX), Core Clinical & EMR Service (Spring Boot), Scheduling & Billing Service (Node.js), FHIR Integration Broker (Python/FastAPI), Notification Worker (Go).
- **Data & Storage**: PostgreSQL, Redis, Apache Kafka, MinIO/AWS S3.
- **Components (Core EMR)**: Patient Demographic Controller, EMR Management Component, Audit Trail Logger, Data Access Repository.

## Relationships
- Users/Patients to API Gateway: HTTPS (TLS 1.3), OpenID Connect (OIDC).
- API Gateway to Internal Containers: gRPC over mTLS.
- CMS to External Lab/Imaging & Clearinghouses: HL7 FHIR over REST/HTTPS.
- CMS to Payment Gateway & Notification Provider: REST/HTTPS.
- Services to Data Stores: PostgreSQL wire protocol, Redis protocol, Kafka protocol, S3 API, all secured via mTLS and AES-256 at rest.

## Technology Stack
- **Frontend/Gateway**: NGINX/Kong for TLS termination and OIDC validation.
- **Backend Services**: Java (Spring Boot) for core EMR, Node.js for scheduling/billing, Python for FHIR, Go for notifications.
- **Databases & Caching**: PostgreSQL with active-active replication for primary data, Redis for <1s P95 read latency.
- **Messaging & Storage**: Apache Kafka for event bus, MinIO/AWS S3 for object storage and immutable audit logs.
- **Infrastructure**: Hybrid deployment across on-premise Kubernetes and AWS `eu-central-1`.

## Rationale
The hybrid architecture distributes workloads across on-premise Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure to meet stringent HIPAA/GDPR data residency mandates. Active-active PostgreSQL replication, Kafka messaging, and Redis caching ensure 99.99% availability and high-performance EMR access.

## Overview
The Clinic Management System is a hybrid cloud platform designed for medium-sized hospitals and clinics to manage patient admissions, electronic medical records, scheduling, and billing. It ensures HIPAA/GDPR compliance, 99.99% uptime, and interoperability with external clinical systems.

## Key Elements
- Users: Doctors, Nurses, Receptionists, Billing Officers, Patients
- API Gateway: Kong/Envoy (on-prem & cloud)
- Web Application: React SPA served via Nginx
- Core Services: Node.js/NestJS microservices
- EMR Service: Java/Spring Boot microservice
- Integration Service: Apache Camel / Node.js
- Async Worker Containers: Python/Celery or Java
- Identity & Policy Container: Keycloak
- Message Broker: Apache Kafka or RabbitMQ
- Cache / State Store: Redis Cluster
- Data Layer: PostgreSQL (Distributed) and MinIO/AWS S3
- External Systems: External Lab/Imaging Systems, Insurance Clearinghouses, Payment Gateway, Notification Service

## Relationships
- Users -> API Gateway: HTTPS (JSON/REST)
- API Gateway -> Identity Container: OIDC/OAuth2
- Core & EMR Services -> PostgreSQL: TLS (TCP/JDBC)
- Core & EMR Services -> Message Broker: AMQP/TLS
- Core Services -> Redis Cluster: TCP/TLS (RESP)
- Integration Service -> External Lab/Imaging: HL7 FHIR over HTTPS
- EMR Service -> Object Storage: HTTPS (S3 API)

## Technology Stack
- Kong/Envoy: Edge routing, mTLS, and OAuth2/MFA enforcement
- React / Nginx: High-performance client-side UI rendering
- Node.js / NestJS: Rapid development of core administrative and billing workflows
- Java / Spring Boot: Robust enterprise transaction management and strict compliance auditing for EMR
- Apache Kafka: Asynchronous decoupling for high availability during external system outages
- Redis Cluster: Active-active distributed locking for scheduling clash checks and rate-limiting
- PostgreSQL: Active-active hybrid replication with AES-256 transparent data encryption
- MinIO / AWS S3: Immutable object locking for mandatory 10-year data retention
- Keycloak: Local token validation and fine-grained RBAC

## Rationale
This architecture uses an active-active hybrid model with decentralized services and asynchronous messaging to guarantee 99.99% availability and strict data protection. Segregating resource-intensive tasks and enforcing robust encryption ensures HIPAA compliance and high-performance EMR delivery under one second.

## Overview
The Clinic Management System is a hybrid cloud platform designed to manage patient admissions, electronic medical records, scheduling, and billing for medium-sized hospitals and clinics. It provides secure, high-availability clinical operations while maintaining strict HIPAA and GDPR compliance.

## Key Elements
- Envoy / Kong API Gateway (Edge Router, Auth Filter, Rate Limiting Plugin, Audit Interceptor, Data Masking Filter)
- Identity & Policy Container (Keycloak)
- Core Services (Node.js / NestJS) & EMR Service (Java / Spring Boot)
- Integration Service (Apache Camel / Node.js)
- Cache / State Store (Redis Cluster)
- Message Broker (Apache Kafka)

## Relationships
- Clients (Doctors, Nurses, Patients) -> Edge Router: TLS 1.3 [HTTPS]
- Edge Router -> Core Services & EMR Service: Upstream requests [gRPC over mTLS]
- Auth Filter -> Identity & Policy Container: JWKS cache sync [HTTPS]
- Rate Limiting Plugin -> Redis Cluster: Token bucket tracking [RESP / TCP]
- Audit Interceptor -> Apache Kafka: Asynchronous audit logs [TCP / Kafka Protocol]
- Edge Router -> Integration Service: FHIR interoperability requests [gRPC / HTTPS]

## Technology Stack
- Envoy: Selected for native gRPC support, Wasm/Lua filters, and sub-millisecond edge routing.
- Keycloak: Provides OIDC/OAuth2 authentication and JWKS synchronization for zero-trust security.
- Redis Cluster: Ensures distributed, sub-millisecond rate-limiting evaluation to prevent traffic spikes.
- Apache Kafka: Enables asynchronous, non-blocking audit log streaming for HIPAA compliance.

## Rationale
This architecture uses an Envoy-based API Gateway with localized JWKS caching and Redis rate-limiting to meet the strict <1s P95 performance budget. Asynchronous Kafka logging and mTLS upstream routing guarantee 99.99% availability and uncompromising HIPAA/GDPR data security.

## Overview
The Clinic Management System is a hybrid cloud platform designed to manage patient admissions, electronic medical records (EMR), scheduling, and billing for medium-sized hospitals and clinics. It ensures high availability (99.99%), strict HIPAA/GDPR compliance, and seamless clinical workflows.

## Key Elements
- **Router & State Controller**: TypeScript and React Router managing client-side navigation and session state enforcement.
- **Auth & Session Manager**: TypeScript module handling OpenID Connect (OIDC) token exchange with Keycloak and enforcing multi-factor authentication (MFA).
- **EMR UI Module**: TypeScript and React component tree optimized for medical records with local caching.
- **Billing & Scheduling UI Module**: TypeScript and React components handling patient registration, appointments, and insurance claims.
- **API Client / Interceptor**: TypeScript and Axios module managing centralized communication and injecting JWT bearer tokens.
- **Offline State & Sync Manager**: TypeScript and browser IndexedDB module with Web Crypto API encryption for transient data.
- **Telemetry & Audit Logger**: TypeScript module capturing client performance metrics and security audit events.

## Relationships
- **UI Modules** to **API Client / Interceptor**: Internal function calls transmitting data via HTTPS (REST/JSON and GraphQL over TLS 1.3).
- **API Client / Interceptor** to **API Gateway**: Network requests over HTTPS (REST/JSON and GraphQL) with injected JWT bearer tokens and audit headers.
- **UI Modules** to **Offline State & Sync Manager**: Local read/write operations using browser IndexedDB with Web Crypto API encryption.
- **Telemetry & Audit Logger** to **API Gateway**: Asynchronous batch event dispatching via HTTPS (REST/JSON).

## Technology Stack
- **React**: Chosen for high-performance client-side UI rendering.
- **TypeScript**: Used across all frontend components for type safety and maintainability.
- **Axios**: Implements centralized HTTP interception and automatic token refresh.
- **IndexedDB with Web Crypto API**: Provides secure, encrypted client-side offline storage.
- **TLS 1.3 / HTTPS**: Ensures secure data-in-transit compliance.

## Rationale
This component architecture fits the requirements by strictly isolating security, compliance, and offline capabilities within the client boundary. Centralized interception and encrypted local storage directly satisfy HIPAA/GDPR mandates and sub-second EMR load performance goals.

Core Services.analysis:
## Overview
The Clinic Management System is a hybrid-cloud healthcare IT platform designed to manage patient admissions, electronic medical records, scheduling, and billing for medium-sized clinics. It ensures high availability (99.99%) and strict HIPAA/GDPR compliance while delivering sub-second EMR performance.

## Key Elements
- **Core Services Container**: NestJS-based backend housing clinical and administrative logic.
- **Patient Management Component**: Handles demographic capture via TypeORM.
- **Scheduling Engine Component**: Manages appointment scheduling and resource clash checks.
- **Billing Service Component**: Processes claims and invoices via HTTP/REST.
- **Audit Logger Component**: Publishes immutable audit trails.
- **Access Control & Policy Enforcer Component**: Validates JWT claims and scopes.
- **FHIR Data Mapper Component**: Translates models into HL7 FHIR standards.
- **Encryption-at-Rest Middleware Component**: Applies AES-256 field-level encryption.
- **Patient Data Repository Component**: Encapsulates data queries and PHI protection.
- **Config & Secret Manager Component**: Fetches dynamic runtime configurations and keys.

## Relationships
- `Scheduling Engine` -> `Cache / State Store`: Read/Write lock states via `TCP/TLS (RESP)`.
- `Billing Service` -> `Insurance Clearinghouses`: Submit claims via `HTTPS/REST`.
- `Audit Logger` -> `Message Broker`: Produce audit events via `AMQP/TLS`.
- `FHIR Data Mapper` -> `Integration Service`: Publish standardized resources via `gRPC/TLS`.
- `Patient Management / Billing` -> `Encryption-at-Rest Middleware`: Encrypt data via `Node.js Crypto Module (AES-256-GCM)`.
- `Patient Data Repository` -> `Data Layer`: Encrypted SQL queries via `TLS (TCP/JDBC)`.
- `Encryption-at-Rest Middleware` -> `Config & Secret Manager`: Retrieve keys via `HTTPS`.
- Internal components -> Access Control / Event Dispatcher: In-process NestJS middleware and `EventEmitter`.

## Technology Stack
- **Backend Framework**: Node.js / NestJS for rapid administrative and billing workflow development.
- **Database & Storage**: PostgreSQL and MinIO/AWS S3 for structured data and file persistence.
- **Caching & State**: Redis Cluster for ultra-low latency scheduling conflict detection.
- **Messaging**: Apache Kafka for asynchronous event distribution and audit logging.
- **Security**: Keycloak for identity management, AES-256-GCM for field-level encryption, and JWT for access control.
- **Interoperability**: Apache Camel and HL7 FHIR APIs for lab and imaging integration.

## Rationale
This architecture uses modular NestJS components with in-process function calls to eliminate network overhead, ensuring P95 EMR screen loads under 1 second. Strict field-level encryption, audit logging, and RBAC mechanisms guarantee full HIPAA and GDPR compliance without compromising the 99.99% active-active availability target.

## Overview
The Clinic Management System is a clinical IT platform that manages patient admissions, electronic medical records, scheduling, and billing for medium-sized hospitals and clinics. It ensures high availability, security compliance, and interoperability across hybrid cloud environments.

## Key Elements
* External Lab/Imaging Systems, Insurance Clearinghouses, Payment Gateway, Identity Provider, Notification Service
* API Gateway (Kong/Envoy), Web Application (React/Nginx), Core Services (Node.js/NestJS), EMR Service (Java/Spring Boot), Integration Service (Apache Camel/Java)
* Integration Service Components: FHIR Ingress/Egress Router, HL7 v2 MLLP Adapter, Schema Validation Component, Data Transformation Engine, Circuit Breaker & Resilience Engine, OAuth2/mTLS Security Interceptor, Dead Letter Channel & Audit Component, Integration Queue Producer, Metrics & Telemetry Publisher
* Async Worker Containers (Python/Celery or Java), Identity & Policy Container (Keycloak)
* Message Broker (Apache Kafka), Cache / State Store (Redis Cluster), Data Layer (PostgreSQL and MinIO/AWS S3)

## Relationships
* Web Application -> API Gateway: Client requests via HTTPS [REST/JSON]
* API Gateway -> Core Services & EMR Service: Internal routing via gRPC/HTTPS [HTTP/2]
* Integration Service (FHIR Ingress/Egress Router) -> External Lab/Imaging Systems: FHIR over HTTPS [HTTPS/JSON]
* Integration Service (HL7 v2 MLLP Adapter) -> External Lab/Imaging Systems: Legacy data ingestion via MLLP [TCP]
* Integration Service (Integration Queue Producer) -> Message Broker (Apache Kafka): Event publishing [TCP/Kafka]
* Integration Service (Circuit Breaker) -> Cache / State Store (Redis Cluster): State synchronization via RESP [RESP/TLS]
* Integration Service (Dead Letter Channel) -> Data Layer (PostgreSQL/MinIO): Audit persistence via JDBC [JDBC/TLS]
* Integration Service (Metrics Publisher) -> Monitoring Stack: Operational telemetry [HTTP/TLS]

## Technology Stack
* Hybrid Cloud (on-prem-k8s and eu-central-1): Meets local legacy integration needs and scalable cloud deployment.
* Apache Camel (Java runtime): Provides robust out-of-the-box healthcare data formats and routing capabilities.
* Apache Kafka: Enables reliable, high-throughput asynchronous messaging between services.
* PostgreSQL and MinIO/AWS S3: Ensures relational data persistence and compliant object storage with AES-256 encryption.
* Redis Cluster: Maintains distributed state for circuit breakers across hybrid nodes.

## Rationale
The hybrid architecture combines on-premise Kubernetes deployment for local MLLP lab integration with AWS cloud scaling to satisfy strict latency and uptime targets. Utilizing Apache Camel alongside robust encryption, auditing, and interoperability standards ensures full HIPAA and GDPR compliance while maintaining 99.99% availability.

## Overview
The Async Worker Containers manage background workloads, long-running clinical sagas, and batch integrations for the Clinic Management System. It ensures HIPAA/GDPR compliance, secure external interoperability, and high availability across hybrid cloud environments.

- Task Dispatcher (Python / Celery)
- Workflow Orchestrator (Temporal)
- Integration Dispatcher (Python / httpx)
- Encryption / Sanitization Component (Python `cryptography`)
- Batch Export Formatter (Python / Jinja2 / Marshmallow)
- Audit Logger Component (Python structlog)
- Dead-Letter Queue (DLQ) Handler (Celery DLQ extensions)
- Worker Health & Metrics Exporter (Prometheus Python Client)

- Audit Logger flushes encrypted records to Data Layer (PostgreSQL) via TLS 1.3.
- Worker Health & Metrics Exporter exposes endpoints scraped by Kubernetes via HTTP/GET.

## Technology Stack
- Python: Primary runtime for all worker components and task processing.
- Temporal: Manages durable, multi-step clinical sagas with built-in audit trails.
- PostgreSQL & Redis: Provides persistent state storage and transient caching via RESP/TLS.
- Prometheus: Collects runtime metrics and container telemetry.

## Rationale
This architecture uses Temporal and Celery for fault-tolerant background processing, guaranteeing 99.99% availability for critical healthcare workloads. Dedicated encryption, sanitization, and audit components ensure strict compliance with HIPAA and GDPR data regulations.

Identity & Policy Container.analysis:
## Overview
The Clinic Management System is a hybrid cloud platform designed to manage patient admissions, electronic medical records, scheduling, and billing for medium-sized hospitals and clinics. It ensures strict HIPAA/GDPR compliance and 99.99% high availability while meeting demanding performance and interoperability standards.

## Key Elements
- **Identity & Policy Container**: Keycloak-based authentication and authorization boundary.
- **Authn Engine**: Built-in Keycloak Authentication SPIs handling MFA and OIDC/OAuth2.
- **Policy Enforcement / RBAC Module**: Evaluates fine-grained roles and user permissions.
- **User Federation Service**: Integrates with external IdPs via LDAP/SAML.
- **Local Token Cache**: Infinispan distributed cache for session synchronization.
- **Audit Logging SPI**: Captures security events for compliance tracking.
- **OAuth2 Token Introspection Module**: Handles token revocation and session termination.
- **API Gateway**: Kong or Envoy routing external traffic.
- **Core Services**: Node.js and NestJS backend for patient, appointment, and billing logic.
- **EMR Service**: Java and Spring Boot service for electronic medical records.
- **Data Layer**: PostgreSQL and MinIO/AWS S3 for data persistence.
- **Message Broker**: Apache Kafka or RabbitMQ for asynchronous event streaming.

## Relationships
- **API Gateway** -> **Authn Engine**: Token validation via local Public Key Cryptography (JWT/JWKS over HTTPS).
- **Policy Enforcement Module** -> **Core Services / EMR Service**: Authorization endpoints via gRPC over mTLS.
- **Audit Logging SPI** -> **Message Broker**: Event publishing via AMQP/Kafka Protocol over TLS.
- **Core Services / EMR Service** -> **OAuth2 Token Introspection Module**: Token validation via gRPC over mTLS.
- **Internal Components** -> **Local Token Cache**: Session synchronization via JGroups over TLS.
- **Authn Engine** -> **Data Layer**: Credential and session persistence via JDBC over TLS.

## Technology Stack
- **Keycloak**: Chosen for enterprise IAM, OIDC/OAuth2 compliance, and extensibility.
- **Infinispan**: Provides sub-millisecond distributed caching for active-active availability (R-06).
- **PostgreSQL & MinIO/S3**: Ensures AES-256 encrypted storage at rest (R-05) with 10+ year data retention.
- **Kafka**: Enables reliable asynchronous event streaming for audit logs and messaging.
- **gRPC over mTLS**: Delivers high-performance, secure internal service-to-service communication.

## Rationale
This architecture uses a hybrid cloud deployment with active-active redundancy to guarantee 99.99% availability and meet stringent HIPAA/GDPR security mandates. Decoupled microservices combined with robust caching and gRPC protocols ensure sub-second EMR performance and seamless clinical workflows.

Data Layer.analysis:
## Overview
The Clinic Management System is a hybrid healthcare platform designed to manage patient records, appointments, and billing with strict regulatory compliance. Its data layer architecture provides secure, highly available, and high-performance data storage across on-premise Kubernetes and AWS (`eu-central-1`).

## Key Elements
- **Primary Relational Store**: PostgreSQL (Multi-Master / Citus or Cloud Managed RDS) for structured EMR, billing, and scheduling data.
- **Audit Logging Store**: Append-only PostgreSQL schema with row-level security for tamper-proof audit trails.
- **Blob Object Store**: MinIO (on-premise) and AWS S3 (cloud) for large medical imaging and lab binary files.
- **Data Access Proxy**: PgBouncer for connection pooling and load distribution.
- **Encryption & Key Management Module**: HashiCorp Vault or AWS KMS providing FIPS 140-2 Level 3 HSM encryption.
- **Replication & Sync Manager**: Debezium and Kafka Connect for hybrid cross-site synchronization.
- **Database Migration & Schema Manager**: Flyway or Liquibase for zero-downtime version-controlled schema upgrades.

## Relationships
- Core Services & EMR Service -> **Data Access Proxy**: TLS (TCP/JDBC) for connection pooling.
- **Data Access Proxy** -> **Primary Relational Store**: TCP/JDBC.
- **EMR Service** -> **Blob Object Store**: HTTPS (S3 API) with pre-signed URLs for binary transfers.
- **Primary Relational Store** -> **Audit Logging Store**: Internal synchronous logical replication.
- **Primary Relational Store** & **Blob Object Store** <-> **Encryption & Key Management Module**: gRPC/HTTPS for envelope encryption and key rotation.
- **Replication & Sync Manager** -> **Primary Relational Store**: TLS (Logical Replication Stream) between `on-prem-k8s` and `eu-central-1`.

## Technology Stack
- **PostgreSQL**: Chosen for robust relational data handling and ACID compliance.
- **MinIO / AWS S3**: Selected for scalable binary object storage supporting long-term retention.
- **PgBouncer**: Implemented to prevent database exhaustion under high hybrid concurrency.
- **Debezium / Kafka Connect**: Utilized for reliable hybrid active-active replication.
- **HashiCorp Vault / AWS KMS**: Deployed to enforce AES-256 encryption at rest and FIPS compliance.
- **Flyway / Liquibase**: Used for atomic, zero-downtime schema evolution.

## Rationale
This 7-component data layer architecture ensures 99.99% availability and sub-second EMR performance via connection pooling and direct object transfers. It strictly enforces HIPAA and GDPR compliance through isolated audit logging, FIPS-compliant AES-256 encryption, and robust multi-master hybrid replication.
